newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Ship seized by S.Lanka rebels said to be N.Korean.
newsitem.headline: Ship seized by S.Lanka rebels said to be N.Korean.

text.p: A cargo ship seized by Tamil Tiger separatists off Sri Lanka's northern coast late on Monday was North Korean and had 38 crew, said the vessel's agent in Colombo.
"The ship, Morang Bong, is registered in North Korea and had 38 North Korean crew," an official of Monsell International, the ship's agents in Sri Lanka, told Reuters on Tuesday.
Earlier reports said the ship had a crew of 10.

"We are waiting for further information," the official said, adding that it was the third trip Morang Bong had made to Jaffna, the former stronghold of the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) rebels.

The LTTE, who are fighting for an independent homeland for minority Tamils in Sri Lanka's north and east, set fire to a refugee ship off the island's northeastern caost last week and took away its nine crew, including two Indonesians.
The Indonesians were released last Friday. The fate of the remaining seven crew of MV Missen was not known.
